backup.title: Backup
backup.subtitle: Full and incremental backups of the database and data folder, stored at a remote location.
backup.ftp_warning: Plain FTP sends your password and backups unencrypted. Use FTPS or SCP when you can, and turn on encryption below.
backup.private_key_hint: Optional. Paste an OpenSSH private key; the password is then used as its passphrase.
backup.host_key_hint: Saved on the first successful test. If the server's key changes, backups stop until you clear this field.
backup.schedule_hint: Cron format, server time. Leave empty to turn off. Default: full on Sunday 03:00, incremental the other days.
backup.keep_full_hint: Older full backups and their incrementals are deleted from the location. 0 keeps everything.
backup.passphrase_hint: Encrypts every backup before upload. Store it somewhere safe: without it a backup cannot be restored.
backup.started: Backup started. It appears in the list below when it is done.
backup.remote_hint: Restore works from here, also on a new server: set up the same location and passphrase first.
backup.name: Backup
backup.restore_text: This replaces the database and data folder with the state of this backup. Changes made after it are lost. The current data folder is kept next to it on the server.

info.channel_hint: Production follows the main branch. Test gets new versions first, from the test branch.
info.up_to_date: You are on the newest {{channel}} version.
info.downgrade: Version {{version}} is the newest on this channel. Installing it goes back to an older version.

quick.title: Quick support
quick.subtitle: Help a customer once, without installing anything on their computer.
quick.connect_help: Ask the customer for the 9-digit code that QuickSupport shows.
quick.consent_note: The customer sees your name and must click Allow before you can see the screen.
quick.download_help: Send the customer this link. They start the file once; nothing is installed and it needs no administrator rights.
quick.not_available: QuickSupport is not available on this server yet. It is installed together with the Windows agent files.
quick.needs_https: This server does not use HTTPS. QuickSupport only connects over an encrypted connection, so set up HTTPS first.
quick.how_1: The customer downloads QuickSupport with the link and starts it.
quick.how_2: QuickSupport shows a 9-digit code. The customer reads it out to you.
quick.how_3: You enter the code here. The customer clicks Allow.
quick.how_4: When you are done, either side ends the session. Closing QuickSupport makes the code invalid.
